index.[t]description: Info on the latest iteration of the Street Fighter series!
index.[t]concept__text:
A new era for fighting games begins in 2023!
The evolution of fighting games starts with our traditional Fighting Ground,
and then we're turning the genre on its head with World Tour and Battle Hub for a total of three modes where anyone can play to their liking.
No one starts off as a champion. You get there step by step, punch by punch.
Take up the challenge and bring your game to the next level.
index.[t]modal__notice_li01_p: Capcom provides various online services for this game, including online-only content.
index.[t]modal__notice_li01_li01: * You cannot access certain elements of this game without an internet connection.
index.[t]modal__notice_li01_li02: * A Capcom ID is required to use use online-only content.
index.[t]modal__notice_li02_p: * For information on the services related to Capcom ID and how to use it, please visit the official Capcom ID website (https://cid.capcom.com/). Please note that there may be times when use of Capcom ID is age-restricted.
index.[t]modal__notice_li02_li01: * For online-only content, a separate paid membership service (PlayStation®Plus for PlayStation®5 or PlayStation®4, Xbox Game Pass Core for Xbox Series X|S) is required.
index.[t]modal__notice_li02_li02: * Capcom may temporarily suspend online services in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
index.[t]top_enlistmentGuide_title: Members wanted for Buckler's Boot Camp
index.[t]top_enlistmentGuide_text:
We're offering a course for newcomers looking to learn the fundamentals of fighting!
Gain access to the data and info you need to take your skills to the next level!
index.[t]top_enlistmentGuide_catch: Wanna break a sweat with us?

product.[t]notes_list_txt: * Due to the design of the game, the Battle Hub is considered the full game, with Fighting Ground and World Tour considered downloadable data that cannot be purchased individually.* The Battle Hub is online-only content. All of World Tour, plus all modes in Fighting Ground except its online portion can be enjoyed offline.* Actual store prices and manufacturer's suggested retail prices may differ. Please check each store for details.* The digital version can be downloaded from the store it was purchased from.* Pre-order and limited bonuses may become available through different means at a later date.* Pre-order bonuses are available to those who pre-order the game before Thursday, June 1 2023, 11:59PM.* The content can be downloaded from the store where the digital version was purchased or via the voucher code provided by the retailer where the physical version was purchased.* Codes can be used only once, and require an internet connection to redeem.* Content and design may change without prior notice.* Images are for illustrative purposes only
product.[t]onlineplay_list_txt: Capcom provides various online services for this game, including online-only content.* You cannot access certain elements of this game without an internet connection.* A Capcom ID is required to use use online-only content.* For information on the services related to Capcom ID and how to use it, please visit the official Capcom ID website（https://cid.capcom.com/). Please note that there may be times when use of Capcom ID is age-restricted.* For online-only content, a separate paid membership service (PlayStation®Plus for PlayStation®5 or PlayStation®4, Xbox Game Pass Core for Xbox Series X|S) is required.* Capcom may temporarily suspend online services in the event of unforeseen circumstances.* A Capcom ID and game account is required. Details can be found here.* In order to play this content, you must have an online internet connection.* In order to play online, a paid Nintendo Switch Online subscription is required.
